series.title: DEBO Student Terminal
series.tagline: Learn by shipping through governed AI workflows.

terminal.font: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, or SF Mono
terminal.lineReveal: natural typing for commands, quick fade for logs

logoAnimation.description: DEBO wordmark boots as a terminal prompt, then the green cursor blinks after the O.
frames: black screen with tiny green cursor

claimPolicy.ordinaryNarration: Lightweight claims are allowed for visible demo actions.

safety.secretsPolicy: never show secrets, keys, tokens, customer names, private IPs, or real credentials
safety.securityPolicy: security scenes must be defensive, scoped, authorized, and non-destructive
safety.studentPolicy: position DEBO as a learning coach and governed teammate, not a replacement for instructors or human judgment

episodes.title: First Run: From Blank Terminal to Learning Plan
episodes.hook: A student opens DEBO and turns a vague goal into a guided learning path.
episodes.cta: Subscribe for the next terminal workflow.

episodes.title: Tests First: Learn by Watching the Guardrails
episodes.hook: DEBO teaches why tests come before code changes.
episodes.cta: Try the workflow with a small practice repo.

episodes.title: Debug Loop: Fix a Failing Student API
episodes.hook: A failing endpoint becomes a readable debugging lesson.
episodes.cta: Save this for your next bug hunt.

episodes.title: Reviewed PR: From Change to Evidence Packet
episodes.hook: DEBO shows students what professional review discipline looks like.
episodes.cta: Use this as your PR checklist.

episodes.title: Mentor Mode: Explain the Code Without Hand-Waving
episodes.hook: The terminal becomes a personal tutor for code comprehension.
episodes.cta: Ask DEBO to explain before you edit.

episodes.title: Safe Security Lab: Learn Defense With Written Scope
episodes.hook: Security learning starts with authorization and non-destructive checks.
episodes.cta: Never run security workflows without scope.
